issues.title: Ingest Conway County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $19,133,804 across 25 funds. The largest: County General ($7,463,969), County Road ($3,951,033), Fire Department ($2,450,090). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.

issues.title: Get the adopted 2026 appropriation ordinance
issues.detail: The filing is a projections workbook, not the adopted ordinance; one fund’s lines are missing and the funds don’t add to its printed total. Ask the county clerk for the ordinance the quorum court adopted, and check these amounts against it.
